articles.summary: FLOWER MOUND, Texas, May 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Mannatech, Incorporated (NASDAQ: MTEX ), ("Mannatech" or "Company"), global health and wellness company committed to transforming lives to make a better world, today announced financial results for its first quarter of 2026. First Quarter Results • Net sales for the three months ended March 31, 2026 were $24.9 million, a decrease of $1.6 million, as compared to the same period in 2025. On a Constant dollar basis (see Non-GAAP Measures, below)
articles.title: Mannatech Reports Financial Results for First Quarter 2026
